title: HDB Resale Flat Price and Cash-over-valuation Trends in Past Year and Support for Families Opting for Resale Flats due to Construction Delays for BTO Flats
what_it_is: HDB Resale Flat Price and Cash-over-valuation Trends in Past Year and Support for Families Opting for Resale Flats due to Construction Delays for BTO Flats

sections.label: COV, BTO delays, resale grants
sections.summary: COV payment rose, HDB may waive forfeiture and wait-out period for affected buyers, and first-timer families can get up to $160,000 in grants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The proportion of buyers who paid a cash-over-valuation (COV) increased from around one in five in 2020 to slightly above one in three in the first half of 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The majority of buyers did not have to pay any COV and the median COV has remained at zero.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: For flat buyers who have been affected by Build-To-Order (BTO) delays and who cancel their BTO flats to buy a resale flat due to urgent housing needs, HDB will consider waiving the forfeiture of the option fee or 5% of the flat purchase price based on an assessment of the flat buyers' specific circumstances.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: HDB will also consider waiving the one-year wait-out period to allow first-time families with urgent housing needs to receive housing grants if they decide to buy a resale flat.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Eligible first-timer families can receive up to $160,000 in grants when they buy a resale flat.

sections.label: Subsidies and flat launches
sections.summary: Increased subsidies can escalate resale prices, and 17,000 flats are on target to launch this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: I say this because we recognise increased subsidies can also lead to an escalation in resale transaction prices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And this year, we are on target to launch 17,000 flats.

sections.label: Next year flat launches
sections.summary: The number of flats launched next year will not be reduced and will be at or above 17,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Having said that, we do not see that we will reduce the number of flats for launch next year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Certainly, it will be at or above 17,000 flats.
